correctness.rationale: Pairwise intersecting 2-element edge sets either have common endpoint (star facet A_i) or are exactly 3 edges of a graph triangle. Degree >=3 ensures stars are maximal and pairwise star intersections contain at most one vertex. After symmetric stellar subdivision of every A_i, descending proper star faces F of size >=3 form elementary free pairs (F,b_i*F) once larger faces removed. Nontriangle incident-edge pairs form final free pairs; triangle pairs survive and precisely form the standard midpoint subdivision of Cl(G)^(2). Every pair has a uniquely determined star center, so stabilizer equality yields an Aut(G)-orbitwise equivariant collapse. For K_n the target is a 2-skeleton of the simplex with 2-chain C2=∧³ Z^n and boundary contraction by ε; kernel is canonically ∧³ker ε, rank C(n-1,3). Read every relevant line of verify.py including literal full-coface assertions, orbit checks and integral cycle action; no extrapolation from tests to all G.
